On the way the tree-minder wants Sithis beard, a grey moss, from the creek below Reed-Sill Weir. 2. Pick the Sithis beard below Reed-Sill Weir, then continue east to Jal-Veesa and Vosh-Leera. 3. answer 1. I killed the two young crocodiles and picked Sithis beard. Weeltul, tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, wants it for the Hist, the great tree in the pool. Vosh-Leera also wants me there. 2. Go east to the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa and give the beard to Weeltul, then find Vosh-Leera. 3. Go straight there; I can talk to people in town on the way. 4. I still do not know why the Hist needs the moss or why Vosh-Leera freed me. I could ask Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. I gave the moss to Weeltul. The Hist is sick: dry dark bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool. The moss only warms the water. Nobody knows the cause. If it dies no eggs hatch and the town empties in a generation. 2. Speak to Vosh-Leera in her house in Jal-Veesa. 3. Talk to Vosh-Leera now, or first ask Weeltul about the sap, scar, eggs and Umbriel. 4. I do not know what caused the sickness, what Umbriel is, or why Vosh-Leera wants me. I can ask Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.
